in_sanskrit.name: Kalyansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Prosperity, Auspiciousness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kalyansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kalyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'kalyana', meaning prosperity, happiness, or auspiciousness. This name is often given to a child born into a prosperous family or during auspicious occasions.
